title: Token Top
description: Track Codex and Claude Code quota usage and local session statistics from the bar.

overview.subtitle: Quota and local activity across your coding agents.

guidance.codex: Run codex login to connect quota usage. Local sessions remain available when present.
guidance.claude: Run claude login to connect quota usage. Local Claude Code sessions remain available when present.

stats.title: Activity
stats.claude_breakdown: Input / Output / Cache write / Cache read

enable_codex.label: Codex · Enable
enable_codex.description: Show Codex quota in the compact bar widget.

enable_claude.label: Claude · Enable
enable_claude.description: Show Claude quota in the compact bar widget.

show_five_hour_bar.label: Codex settings · Show 5-hour limit in bar
show_five_hour_bar.description: Display Codex's 5-hour percentage and tooltip row in the bar when Codex is selected.

show_five_hour_panel.label: Codex settings · Show 5-hour limit in panel
show_five_hour_panel.description: Display Codex's 5-hour quota in Overview and the Codex detail view.

show_claude_five_hour_bar.label: Claude settings · Show 5-hour limit in bar
show_claude_five_hour_bar.description: Display Claude's 5-hour percentage and tooltip row in the bar when Claude is selected.

show_claude_five_hour_panel.label: Claude settings · Show 5-hour limit in panel
show_claude_five_hour_panel.description: Display Claude's 5-hour quota in Overview and the Claude detail view.

color.label: Text color
color.description: Color role or hex value for usage text in the bar.

icon_color.label: Icon color
icon_color.description: Color role or hex value for the Codex icon. The Claude logo keeps its brand color.
